_doc: /whatsnew and /tour (ADR 0130): recent additions in tour order, first at home (interface, machines, power, the book), then out into the world biome by biome. Any lane adds an entry where it fits: id (one word, /tour <id>), title, what (one or two sentences: what to look for), run (command lines a click or /tour runs, in order; may be empty), date. test_whats_new.gd checks every line is a known command with real arguments and that every place is found. A travel stop starts with /spawn, so /goto searches (4 km, or the km after the place, up to 16) from where the test does (0, 0 on seed 1337), not from the last stop.

entries.title: Quality of life
entries.what: F7 marks dark ground red (yellow: dark at night), hold Z to zoom, F1 hides the HUD, Alt + wheel swaps hotbar rows, middle click sorts, Craft in the recipe view. Home is set here: /home brings you back between stops.

entries.title: Sleeves on body clothing
entries.what: Worn body clothing has sleeves: F5 for the third-person view, or see the inventory portrait (E).

entries.title: Six LV machines
entries.what: Extractor (resin and rubber from logs), cutter, extruder, canning machine, compressor and electrolyzer on a powered line, each with its own model and its own hum. The electric kit feeds them.

entries.title: A 48 V factory with switch, fuse and breaker
entries.what: Look at a cable or hold the multimeter: volts, amps, watts. Open the knife switch (it clunks), overload a thin cable until it burns, trip the breaker. /blocks lists every machine's readings.

entries.title: Small power: wheel, wind, crank
entries.what: A water wheel, a wind turbine and a hand crank feed a meter panel, a fuse, a battery of lead-acid cells and two lamps behind a daylight switch. Watch the meter's bars and the lamps come on at night; wind lulls drop the turbine.

entries.title: The Workshop chapter
entries.what: LV round 2: canned food that gives its tin back, sticky resin, rubber boots, a diving mask, a spyglass, a hand drill. The book opens on the chapter; the kit has the goods.

entries.title: The Hunting tab
entries.what: The recipe browser says which animal drops fur, feathers, antlers and hides; tooltips give a machine's watts and a cable's rating.

entries.title: Steam is white again
entries.what: Steam no longer draws brown against the sky. /count steam says how many cells the sim holds.

entries.title: Wooden lookouts and bluebells
entries.what: A log tower with a plank platform 5.5 m up; its pots hold furs and lenses. Bluebells grow under the trees, and the journal notes the landmark when you come near.

entries.title: Rope bridges
entries.what: Sagging plank decks on ropes between log posts span the ravines, about one every 64 m of ravine.

entries.title: Abandoned mines: lined, and LV loot
entries.what: The head-frame and decline sit on a timber lining, nothing hangs. Mine pots hold wire, cable, gears, a valve or a primitive circuit, rarely a machine hull.

entries.title: Cairns, moss campion and goats
entries.what: Stone cairns stand on the mountains and peaks, moss campion grows between the rocks, goats climb up there.

entries.title: Heather
entries.what: Heather carpets in patches over the highlands and the scrub.

entries.title: Lingonberries
entries.what: Low lingonberry under the spruce of the taiga and the snowy taiga.

entries.title: Igloos, snow hares, ptarmigan
entries.what: Igloos on the ice fields and snowy lands (fish and bone needles inside), frost lichen and tundra sedge in the snow, and the frozen biomes have animals now.

entries.title: Desert tombs and desert life
entries.what: A tomb in desert stone with salt and grave goods; desert marigolds; lizards, scorpions (they sting with poison) and vultures, each with its own call.

entries.title: Hoodoos and sagebrush
entries.what: Rock spires over the badlands, sagebrush around them; the journal notes them when you come near.

entries.title: Rock arches
entries.what: A natural stone arch, a journal landmark.

entries.title: Antelope herds and aloe
entries.what: Antelope on the savanna, shrubland and badlands; aloe among the grass.

entries.title: Jungle temples and parrots
entries.what: A temple in jungle stone with rubber in its pots; bromeliads on the floor, parrots perching.

entries.title: Cattails
entries.what: Tall cattail stands in the swamp.

entries.title: Dune grass, sea aster and gulls
entries.what: Clumps of dune grass above the tide line, sea aster on stony shores; gulls land along the coast and mackerel shoal in the sea.

entries.title: Fire lilies
entries.what: Fire lilies grow on the volcanic land. Mind the lava.

entries.title: Magma salamanders
entries.what: Glow-spotted salamanders hiss in magma and sulfur caves.

entries.title: A still lake stays still
entries.what: Arriving at a lake no longer wakes the water: F3 should show the sim quiet and frames smooth. Dig a pit at the shore: it still fills. /home when you are done.
